free_resources.title: Learn Meditation for Wellbeing: Counting the Breath
free_resources.description: Step-by-step instructions, adapted from Daizan's book Practical Zen for Health, Wealth and Mindfulness, for the beginner's 'counting the breath' meditation: posture on a chair, kneeling, cross-legged or lying down, then counting breaths from one to ten, followed by a few minutes of free writing. The page also links a free guided recording of the practice in several languages.

flags: The page says this beginner style suits people looking for stress reduction, better sleep or ways to deal with pain; that is wellbeing wording with no claim to treat a condition, so it passes the 12 Nov rule.
